---

## Business incident / request

What did the fictional customer or on-call team observe, and why does it matter?

## System context

Describe the relevant source files, architecture, data contracts and dependencies.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Correct business outcome demonstrated
- [ ] Reproducible tests and observed logs
- [ ] Failure mode reproduced and diagnosed
- [ ] Change delivered through a pull request
- [ ] Reviewer accepts reasoning and operational risks

## Learning objectives

Concepts the learner needs to discover while solving the ticket.

## Evidence required

Attach real commands and test outputs, not fabricated metrics.

## Security and cleanup

No personal data, cloud keys, public development APIs or unapproved cloud spending.
